sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
For other uses, see Lilith.

Lilith is a character introduced in Brave Frontier I as a unit. In Brave Frontier II, Lilith appears as an NPC.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: In Brave Frontier I, Lilith can be summoned as a unit.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Lilith is the third humanoid weapon developed by Reeze
